name: headless-app-tanstack
title: Headless App for TanStack Start
description: Give your agents a backend: sign-in, OAuth consent, an MCP server, and a page to connect and revoke agents.
docs: Set `site_url` in `supabase/config.toml` to the origin serving your app, and `PRODUCT_NAME` in `routes/_protected/agents.tsx`. Change the database by editing `supabase/schemas/public/tables/tasks.sql` and running `supabase db diff -f <name>`; add tools in `supabase/functions/mcp-server/tools/`. Deploy with `supabase db push`, `supabase config push`, and `supabase functions deploy mcp-server`, then sign in and open `/agents` to connect an agent.
